task: Make incremental reviewer context mechanically safe and auditable instead of caller-selected.
outcome: When an operator runs lattice review_incremental_context for an eligible reviewer lane, the terminal shows contextMode=incremental with stable eligibility reason codes, impacted files, reviewBasis, and the bound prior pass. For any stale, unknown, public-contract, policy, authority, scope, parse, or untrusted case, it shows contextMode=full and a precise escalation reason; attempts to force incremental or submit a pass with a mismatched incremental Prompt Envelope are rejected. The read-only command does not change lifecycle gate state.
facts: Story 2 already defines and validates full-context Prompt Envelopes and currently rejects incremental envelopes.
The existing review_incremental_context command is read-only and reports prior verdict, bound head, rename-aware changed files, and scopeChanged.
Canonical freshness comes from checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit, which needs a stable versioned classification for incremental use while preserving legacy consumer behavior.

The shared admissibility chain is review_run_start, assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence, verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope, validateEvidenceRunBinding, and collectReviewerEvidenceState; REVIEW, readiness, preflight, status, and quorum already consume it.

The only v1 bounded categories supported by current proof machinery are metadata-only/no material delta and pure test-fixture deltas with complete checklist files.test plus current story-scoped intentRef bindings.
Docs routing is not a complete reverse-reference graph and semantic scope is not a repository-complete call index, so docs-only and private implementation remain full in v1.
B-8d4b completed the replay and measurement prerequisite.
constraints: Unknown or unprovable impact must fail closed to full context.
The main agent, caller parameters, and prompt prose cannot force incremental eligibility.

Public API, schema, protocol, command authority, permission, gate, dependency, build-entry, docs-only, private implementation, dynamic reference, parse failure, and unsupported rename changes default to full in v1.
Incremental mode must not restrict reviewer access to current authoritative material.
review_incremental_context must remain read-only and non-gating.
Gate-consumed facts require registry and contract-verifier coverage.
Do not create a second reviewer evidence authority or migrate roles assigned to Stories 5-7.
